title: Canary: Project-Health and Operator-Attention Observability for Indie+Agent Developers
description: Companion artifact for the paper *The Metadatafication of Version Control: How AI Agents Transform Git from Tool to Infrastructure*. Contains the manuscript source (paper/main.tex), the experiment scripts that produced the §5.4 push-leakage and §5.5 CAM/ACR/adoption-timeline tables (experiments/src/), sanitized JSON snapshot data (experiments/results/), and a Next.js + Model Context Protocol service (app/, components/, lib/, mcp/) that operationalizes the framework as a running instrument.
